cohort: The study participants were Black and non-Hispanic White very low birth weight (<1500g) or very preterm infants (22-29 weeks gestational age) from California between 2014 and 2018.
finding: Varying standard methods of cohort selection resulted in neonatal mortality ranges from 6.2% to 16.0%, and across all cohorts, a 16-30% survival advantage was found for Black infants after risk adjustment.
